findings.title: Trust and sound work become enduring reception
findings.claim: In the focus, trust and deliberately sound work can be read together as a movement from transient provision toward arrival in an enduring garden, where the recipients are received as fitting guests.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers 18:107:3, 18:107:4, 18:107:5, and 18:107:10 contact the coordinated work qualification and garden-reception predicate; the independent 18:45 connection supplies the transient-water contrast. Together they make the nuzul carrier feel like settled arrival and prepared reception rather than bare downward movement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reward clause becomes an arrival scene: trust and sound work qualify the people who arrive, while the garden supplies a lasting place of reception.
findings.containment: The direct reward assertion remains intact. This does not replace the ordinary trust-belief and righteous-deeds reading, activate every sense under any of the four roots, or claim that the transient-water image is the only wider comparison.

epistemic.reason: The citable trusted publication supplies exact focus anchors and all five branch references; the accepted branch records provide the lexical boundaries, and the supplied same-surah connection provides the independent contrast.

findings.title: Prepared hospitality for the arriving righteous

The reader walk supplies 18:102 as an independent reception contrast and connects it to the focus occurrences for righteous work and gardens, so the same reception category is differentiated by destination and qualification.

findings.containment: The direct promise of gardens remains recoverable. The reader walk is legacy_unbound and non-citable, so the 18:102 contrast is qualified; this finding does not decide whether the repeated nuzul is neutral or ironic in every context.
